transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in today because... ever since my grandson was killed, something just isn't right with me. I can't seem to feel anything good anymore. 

My daughter can sit right beside me, holding my hand, and in my head I know I love her. I know that. But I just cannot feel the warmth of it inside me at all. It's like that part of me is just completely blank.
How long have you been feeling this way, since your grandson passed away?
It has been six days now. This has been going on for the six days since he was killed right outside the community center.
Are you able to enjoy things you normally liked before your grandson passed away?

No, I really can't. Like I was just saying about sitting with my daughter... I just can't feel any of that joy or goodness anymore. I used to enjoy my days and the things I'd do, but right now, no. I can't feel happy about anything at all. It's just empty.
Do you feel guilty about your grandson's death?

No... no, I don't feel guilty. I know it wasn't my fault. I didn't have anything to do with what happened to him out there. So it's not guilt I'm feeling. It's just... well, like I said, just that empty feeling.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time since your grandson passed away?

I wouldn't really call it sad. I mean... I haven't been crying all day or feeling that heavy sorrow you might expect. It's really just... like I was saying, it's just an empty feeling. I just feel kind of blank most of the time.
Are you able to find pleasure in things that you used to find pleasurable before your grandson's death?
Well, like I mentioned just a moment ago, no. I really can't. There's just no pleasure in any of the things I used to do. It all just goes back to that same blank feeling I was telling you about.
Have you been having trouble sleeping since your grandson passed away?
No, I haven't really had any trouble with that. I sleep about the same as I always have. I just go to bed and... well, I sleep. So no, that hasn't been a problem.
Have you been having any thoughts about harming yourself since your grandson passed away?
No, I haven't. I don't have any thoughts like that. I know I said I just feel empty and blank, but... well, I wouldn't ever do anything to hurt myself. So, no.
Have you been feeling tired or having low energy since your grandson passed away?

No, I wouldn't say I've been feeling tired or having low energy. My energy levels are about the same as they've always been. I just... I just don't have the desire to do much of anything, but it's not because I'm physically tired.
Have you noticed any change in your weight since your grandson passed away?
No, I haven't noticed any change in my weight. I think it's stayed about the same as always. My clothes still fit the way they usually do, so... no, no changes there.
Have you been having any recurring negative thoughts or thoughts that you can't stop thinking about since your grandson passed away?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't have thoughts stuck in my head that I can't stop. It's really just... well, mostly just that empty feeling I mentioned before. But no, no specific negative thoughts going around and around.
Are you unable to feel pleasure in things that normally would bring you happiness?

Yes, that is actually the main reason I came in. Since my grandson was killed, I just haven't been able to feel those good things anymore. My daughter can sit right beside me and hold my hand, and... I know I love her, but I cannot feel the warmth of it inside me at all.
Do you think this empty feeling might get better over time or has it been changing at all since it started six days ago?

I... I really don't know. I hope it gets better eventually, but right now... no. It hasn't changed at all in the last six days. It's just been exactly the same empty feeling every single day since it happened.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks in the past where you felt depressed or lost interest in activities?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've had sad days over the years, of course, but never a whole two weeks of feeling depressed or losing interest in things like this. This is... this is completely different from anything I've experienced before.
Have you noticed any change in how you move or react physically since your grandson passed away?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean... I'm mostly just sitting in my chair at home these days, but my body works the same as it did before. I don't think my movements or physical reactions have changed at all.
Do you feel detached from others or like you're observing life from outside your body?

Yes, I actually do. It's... well, it's hard to describe. Sometimes my own living room just looks flat and strange to me, almost like I'm looking at it through church glass. And... yes, about the body thing. I feel as if I'm just watching this old woman move around, instead of being fully in my own body.
Do you find yourself wanting to do things you normally do, but just can't seem to start them?

No, I wouldn't say that. It's not that I want to do my usual things and just can't get started... I just don't really have the desire to do them at all right now. The wanting to do them just isn't there.
Are you finding that you have no interest in doing things that you used to enjoy?

Well... I suppose it's like I said just a moment ago. I just don't have the desire to do much of anything right now. The things I used to like doing... I just don't care about them anymore. The interest just isn't there.
Would you say your lack of interest in activities is a significant change from how you used to be?

Yes, it really is a big change. I used to be quite active, always finding something to keep me busy or something I enjoyed doing. Now... I just sit here, and none of it matters to me anymore. It's very different from how I've been my whole life.
Would you say that the things you used to enjoy doing have lost their appeal to you since your grandson passed away?
Yes, that's exactly it. Like I was just saying, they really have. Ever since he passed away... I just don't have it in me to care about those things anymore. The appeal is just completely gone.
